'''Forfra moss''' was a pungent [[Moss/Legends|moss]] that grew on the ceilings of underground [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]],<ref name="Dragon of the Desert" /> located in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]<ref name="Cularin">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The moss was slow-growing and was [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by the legendary [[k'kayeh dragon]], a creature created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]]. As the moss was [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] to the k'kayeh dragon during some parts of its development cycle, the creature waited to eat it until its smell was unmistakable.<ref name="Dragon of the Desert" />

==Behind the scenes==
Forfra moss was mentioned in "[[Dragon of the Desert]]," a tie-in article to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Living Force]] campaign that was written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[July 8]], [[2002]].<ref name="Dragon of the Desert" />
